name: Portici (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Portici (a navy blue eagle on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Portici, a comune in Campania; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Portici arms — navy blue eagle on blue, crowned, within branches
